about_the_game:
Step into the unsettling world of MIRROR MIRROR with this exclusive demo. Explore the eerie, dimly lit house and experience the creeping dread that lurks around every corner. The demo offers a glimpse into the full game's looping structure, allowing you to navigate a few levels of the house, uncovering its sinister secrets and eerie events.

Demo Info

Tension builds with every step as the environment shifts, shadows move when you're not looking, and reality distorts in unsettling ways. Experience the psychological horror firsthand as the house reacts to your presence, luring you deeper into its nightmare. And just when you think you're safe, the jump scares will remind you that you're never alone.

Dare to enter the loop—can you escape the reflection?

 Features:

  • VHS-Inspired Photorealistic Visuals – Immerse yourself in a grainy, atmospheric world that blurs the line between reality and nightmare.

  • A Carefully Crafted Narrative – Experience a story-driven journey told through environmental storytelling, cryptic messages, and haunting discoveries.

  • A Puzzle of Memories – Piece together fragmented clues to uncover the truth behind the ever-changing house.

  • Unrelenting Tension – Every turn could bring something new—or something waiting. Stay alert, because nothing is ever as it seems.

content_descriptors.notes: MIRROR MIRROR contains depictions of violence and accident news reports, though these events are not shown on screen. And -only blood- are visually presented to you, and you encounter bloodstains at certain points during the cycles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I3 9TH GEN or AMD RYZEN 3 2ND GEN
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RADEON RX 570
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum system requirements mean that you will be able to play the game at Low - Med settings at 60 frames with Full HD resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5 10TH GEN or AMD RYZEN 5 3RD GEN
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 Super or AMD RADEON RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended system requirements mean that you will be able to play the game in High - Ultra settings at 60 frames with Full HD resolution.

short_description: MIRROR MIRROR is a first-person psychological horror game. You repeatedly find yourself in a house where your find presence of unknown entities. Go through unreal experiences in the house and uncover the secrets of your fractured mind. Experience the tension and fear in the repeating space.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
